name: Shrimp "Summer Roll" Bowl with Rice, Veggies & Peanut Sauce (Prep-Ahead)

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium and 4 mini food storage containers.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the rice is cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 English cucumber
1 red bell pepper
1 bunch radish
½ small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap) and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, add shrimp and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 2 minutes. Drain in a clean colander and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside to drain.
While the shrimp are cooking, trim and cut cucumber into thin matchsticks. Place on a plate.
Trim, seed, and cut bell pepper into thin matchsticks. Add to the plate with the cucumber.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the plate.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the plate.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the plate, along with shredded carrots, and set aside.
Divide peanut sauce between the mini storage containers and set aside.
When the rice is done, transfer to a large baking sheet pan, spread out in an even layer, and set aside to cool, about 15 minutes.

When the rice is cool, divide between the medium storage containers. Top with shrimp, veggies, and herbs. Add peanut sauce to the containers, cover, and refrigerate until ready to eat. Drizzle rice bowls with peanut sauce and enjoy!
